answer_text:
Here is a comprehensive guide to making **federal tax payments online** through the IRS:

---

## 💻 How to Pay Federal Taxes Online

The IRS offers several convenient options for paying your federal taxes electronically. You can make a tax payment anytime online, from your bank account, with a card, or by mail.

---

### ✅ Option 1: IRS Direct Pay (FREE)
**🔗 [IRS Direct Pay](https://www.irs.gov/payments/direct-pay-with-bank-account)**

Pay personal or business taxes directly from your bank account with IRS Direct Pay. It's free and secure. You can pay balance due, federal tax deposits, and other federal income tax, but a payment can't exceed $10 million. To make a higher payment, use the Electronic Federal Tax Payment System (EFTPS) or same-day wire.

---

### ✅ Option 2: IRS Online Account (FREE)
**🔗 [IRS.gov/Account](https://www.irs.gov/account)**

Go to IRS.gov/Account to log in and make a payment, make a tax payment directly from your checking or savings account, and view your balance, payment plan details and options, digital copies of certain notices, and more.

You can pay your tax balance due, estimated payments, or part of a payment plan. Penalties and interest will continue to grow until you pay the full balance. Pay now or schedule payments up to a year in advance.

---

### ✅ Option 3: Electronic Federal Tax Payment System (EFTPS)
**🔗 [EFTPS.gov](https://www.eftps.gov)**

Set up the Electronic Federal Tax Payment System (EFTPS) for individual or business tax payments. Note that new EFTPS accounts can take up to five business days to process.

Businesses can now make most common business tax payments, including estimated taxes and federal tax deposits, through their business tax account or Direct Pay for businesses. Some business tax payments must still be made through EFTPS.

---

### ✅ Option 4: Debit Card, Credit Card, or Digital Wallet
**🔗 [IRS Card Payments](https://www.irs.gov/payments/pay-your-taxes-by-debit-or-credit-card)**

You can pay online or over the phone, and you can pay using digital wallets such as PayPal and Click to Pay. Processing fees apply. Your card statement will list your payment as "United States Treasury Tax Payment."

---

### ✅ Option 5: IRS2Go Mobile App (FREE)
Use the IRS2Go mobile app for easy and secure mobile payments.

---

### 📅 Estimated Tax Payments
Taxes must be paid as you earn or receive income during the year, either through withholding or estimated tax payments. If the amount of income tax withheld from your salary or pension is not enough, or if you receive income such as interest, dividends, alimony, self-employment income, or capital gains, you may have to make estimated tax payments.

Individuals, including sole proprietors, partners, and S corporation shareholders, generally have to make estimated tax payments if they expect to owe tax of $1,000 or more when their return is filed.

---

### ⚠️ Important Notes
- The IRS encourages you to pay your taxes in full because penalties and interest will continue to grow until you pay the full balance.
- If you can't pay in full, you can find details on payment plan types: simple, streamlined, in-business trust fund express, guaranteed, and partial payment installment agreements.
- You can also check if you can settle your debt for less than you owe with an Offer in Compromise.

---

**🔗 Main IRS Payments Page: [IRS.gov/Payments](https://www.irs.gov/payments)**
